summary: Independently verified all 4 round-2 features (cron reminders, watermarked signed-PDF download, event ICS/Google-Calendar links, public Ambassador Directory search) plus the 2 quick regression items. Created /app/backend/tests/test_round2_features.py (21 tests, all passing) and ran 3 Playwright UI flows against the preview URL (public /directory, /portal/documents, /portal/events, notification bell). No functional defects found.
verified: POST /api/cron/reminders: 401 no auth, 401 wrong bearer, 200 {ok:true,run_id} with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, 200 {duplicate:true} on replay of same X-Webhook-Id (single reminder_runs row).

Fresh-run proof: cleared reminder_sent + type=reminder notifications, triggered cron -> 4 dedupe keys recreated (onboard:mem_amb1:2026-W34, goal:goal1, goaldir:goal1, inact30:user_amb1) and 3 portal notifications for user_amb1 (Onboarding reminder, Goal reminder, We miss you). Zero accounts deactivated (users/members all account_status=active).

GET /api/signatures/sig1/pdf: owner 200 application/pdf (%PDF-, 2615 bytes, Content-Disposition attachment), staff tok_admin 200, other ambassador 403, anonymous 401, unknown id 404. GET /api/documents as amb returns signed_by_me=true + signature_id=sig1.
GET /api/events/evt1/ics: 200 text/calendar with BEGIN:VCALENDAR, VERSION:2.0, VEVENT, UID:evt1@cec-connect, DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20260904, SUMMARY:CEC Career Day; unknown id 404.

GET /api/public/directory: base returns Amara Bell; state=Georgia&focus=Education -> 1 result Amara Bell; state=Texas -> []; focus=Nonexistent -> []; q=amara -> Amara Bell, q=zzzz -> []; no _id leaked.

UI /directory: search box, state filter, focus filter, result count and Clear all work (Georgia+Education keeps Amara Bell, zzzz shows 'No ambassadors match' empty state, Clear resets inputs and grid).

UI /portal/documents (cookie session_token=tok_amb): doc-doc1 card shows enabled 'Signed PDF' button data-testid=download-signed-doc1 -> /api/signatures/sig1/pdf; in-browser credentialed fetch returned 200 application/pdf 2615 bytes.

UI /portal/events: gcal-evt1 href = calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE...dates=20260904/20260905 and ics-evt1 href = /api/events/evt1/ics (fetch 200, text/calendar). Both buttons enabled, no console errors.
UI notification bell shows badge 3 with the three reminder notifications rendered.
Regression: GET /api/files/{id}/download anonymous -> 401; PUT /api/goals/goal1 as another member -> 403 and goal title unchanged.
action_items: Optional (test-harness only, no app bug): 3 pre-existing tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py fail under pytest-xdist because they depend on state created by tests in other classes/workers (TestApplicationsAdmin::test_detail_notes_status_flow, ::test_convert_to_member 'ambassador submission test must run first') and TestUsersAudit::test_change_user_role indexes an empty user list. Make these tests self-contained (create their own application/user) so the legacy suite is order-independent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1368 lines — consider splitting reminders/signature-pdf/ics into routers/modules (>700-line guideline).

cron_reminders uses asyncio.create_task(run_reminders()) with no exception logging; wrap run_reminders in try/except + logger.exception so a silent failure in a background reminder run is observable (currently a crash mid-run leaves partial dedupe keys and no trace).
run_reminders inserts the dedupe key in _remind_once BEFORE sending; if notify/email fails the key still blocks a retry for that bucket. Acceptable for idempotency but worth noting.

GET /api/events/{id}/ics is unauthenticated and leaks event name/description/location for ANY event id including non-public/Pending ones. Consider restricting to public/Approved events or requiring auth.
_fmt_ics_date silently falls back to today on parse failure — an invalid stored date would produce a wrong calendar entry rather than an error.
